jobs.title: BI Data Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re hiring: BI Data Engineer | Brussels | Hybrid

Are you passionate about turning complex data into scalable, reliable and actionable solutions?
We are looking for an experienced BI Data Engineer
to join a large-scale international technology environment in Brussels.

🔹 What you’ll be working on

🏗️ Design and develop Enterprise Data Warehouses, Data Lakes & Data Lakehouses

🔄 Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines
and orchestration workflows
📊 Develop scalable data models, dashboards, KPIs and self-service BI solutions
⚡ Work with near-real-time ingestion and Change Data Capture (CDC)

☁️ Contribute to cloud, on-premises and hybrid data architectures
🔍 Improve performance through SQL/query optimization, indexing and partitioning
🛡️ Implement data quality, lineage, governance, observability and GDPR-compliant practices
🚀 Support automated testing and deployments through CI/CD

🤝 Collaborate with architects, developers, analysts and business stakeholders

🔎 What we’re looking for
✔ Strong SQL
and relational database expertise
✔ Experience with Enterprise Data Warehousing & dimensional modelling

✔ Experience with Data Lake / Data Lakehouse architectures

✔ Strong ETL/ELT and data integration
experience
✔ Experience with Power BI, Tableau or Qlik

✔ Knowledge of tools such as Azure Data Factory, dbt, Informatica or Talend

✔ Experience with cloud data platforms
✔ Understanding of data governance, lineage and data quality

✔ Excellent English communication skills
✔ French is a plus

🎓 Relevant Microsoft, Azure, AWS or BI/Data Engineering certifications are a strong advantage.

📍 Brussels, Belgium

🏠 Hybrid working model

⏱️ Full-time

Interested in working on complex, large-scale data environments? We’d be happy to hear from you.
